title: Annotatio V §.IV open: From the same fundamental principle — judge both Consensus and Consociation
pass_a_gloss: §. IV. From the same principle of the same fundamental dogmas of the Christian Religion both the Consensus of Christians and Consociation — that is, both Unity of mind or Spirit and Unity of Body or Church — are to be judged.
pass_b_english: §. IV. From that same principle of the Christian religion’s fundamental dogmas we must judge both Christians’ Consensus and their Consociation —
that is, both unity of mind (or Spirit) and unity of body (or Church).
source_text:
§. IV.
Ex eodem oppidò fundamentalium Christianae Religionis dogmatum eorundem Principio tàm Consensus Christianorum, quam Consociatio, id est tam Unitas mentis seu Spiritus, quam Unitas Corporis, seu Ecclesiae, dijudicanda.
